about: The attacks of each design/enemies.json row (docs/11-ENEMIES.md). slot primary/secondary replaces that slot's skill on the cloned vanilla body (the vanilla AI drivers for that slot then use it); slot passive is a component, not a skill (the Medic's heal pulse). kind maps to an EntityState tagged [Kind] in plugin/Enemies (or the passive component). damagePct: x the body's damage (2.0 = 200 %). reach: the hit's own range (melee box length, m). minRange/maxRange: the AI driver's distance band for using it (0 = keep the vanilla driver's). windup: seconds before the hit (the counter-play); duration: the whole move. projectileSpeed m/s. radius/healPct/healPctBoss/interval: the heal pulse (healPct of the ally's max health every interval within radius; champions get healPctBoss). clip: the model's clip played. castSound/hitSound: Deadlock sound events (only those whose files are in the creator's NPC folder: the Medic's heal and the melee hit point at files it lacks). ror2Sound: a Risk of Rain 2 sound event played as well (the Medic's chime). color: the move's effect colour (hex). expect: what test mode checks it does (target_damage: the player is hurt; ally_heal: a hurt monster in range gains health; projectile: a projectile flies). Unused cells are 0 or none. affix: a RoR2 elite buff (BuffDef name) the enemy carries for good and that does this passive instead of our own heal (creator, 2026-11-11: the Medic heals "the same way with the same vfx" as the Mending elite: bdEliteEarth, its green tethers, its heal, its healer core on death); the affix supplies the tethers (set to radius and maxTargets) while the heal stays ours: the nearest maxTargets hurt allies in radius get healPct of their max health each interval (creator, 2026-11-11: "heal up to 3 enemys at a time make them a big problem so the player is forced to deal with them first"); ror2Sound unused. clip none: no attack clip, the enemy stands in its idle while it attacks (creator, 2026-11-11: "the animation played is bad can we just keep them stading idel"; then the Melee Trooper's swing back: "THE ... MELEE TROOPER ARE NOT ... DOUING THEIR ANIMATION").
